### Description

> Describe what this PR changes, why it is needed, and any relevant background.
>
> Do not assume reviewers already know the context. Call out behavioral changes, breaking changes, API updates, tradeoffs, and alternatives if they matter.
>
> If the UI changes, include screenshots or recordings.

### References

> Add links relevant to this change, for example:
>
> - issue or task
> - related PRs
> - design doc
> - external discussion or bug report
>
> If there are no references, remove this section.

### Testing

> Describe how reviewers can verify this change.
>
> Be explicit about what was tested, what was not tested, and why.
>
> Include manual verification steps when automated coverage is not enough.
>
> Also note the environment used during development when it matters, such as OS, browser, Node.js, or .NET SDK version.

- [ ] This change adds or updates tests where needed

### Checklist

- [ ] I updated documentation when required
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks for the affected area
- [ ] I added screenshots for visible UI changes
- [ ] I used the correct base branch
